comparable_sales.criteria_text: Similar type: same DOF building class category "01 ONE FAMILY DWELLINGS". Similar size: recorded gross floor area within +/-50% of the subject's recorded 2,400 sq ft. Market sales only: $0 sales (transfers without cash consideration, per DOF) are excluded. The subject lot itself is excluded. Candidates with no recorded gross floor area are listed separately, not size-matched.
comparable_sales.not_a_valuation: These are recorded sales selected by a simple, disclosed filter, not a valuation or an appraisal. How "similar type and size" should be defined is a product choice to confirm with the owner.

unused_floor_area.detail: Remaining development capacity: Not confirmed. Needs verified zoning-lot boundaries and existing zoning floor area. Existing zoning floor area on file: 6,200 sq ft (Stated assumption). Unused floor area is the zoning floor-area allowance minus the existing zoning floor area. The allowance and the subtraction are the rule engine's (Lane A), which is off; this data layer supplies only the existing-floor-area input and never computes a remaining capacity.
